sources.entry: SickChill | Automatic Video Library Manager for TV Shows

summary.one_liner: SickChill is an automatic video library manager for TV shows that watches for new episodes, then searches, downloads, renames, and organizes them.
summary.what_it_does: It monitors your favorite TV shows and handles new episodes when they air, including automatic torrent and NZB searching, sending to your client, and post-download processing at chosen qualities. It can rename, sort, and process episodes, and download posters, banners, and fanart, generating NFO/TBN files. It shows which episodes are missing or airing soon, and supports mass-failing seasons or episodes to force retries. Metadata comes from TheTVDB, AniDB, IMDb, FanArt.tv, TVmaze and others, with XEM scene numbering, alternate season orders, subtitle matching, and anime support. Notifications can go to Kodi, XBMC, Trakt, Twitter and others. It is accessed through a simple HTTP interface.
use_cases: organize and rename TV show files
track missing episodes and upcoming airings
manage a Kodi or XBMC TV library
search torrent and newznab providers for shows
how_to_run: Start SickChill from the project directory using its Python entry point (see the README's installation wiki link for exact steps)
Open the HTTP web interface in a browser to configure shows and providers
notable: Large list of supported torrent, newznab, and torznab providers, public and private
XEM scene numbering and multiple season orders (aired, DVD, absolute)
Kodi/XBMC library updates and NFO/TBN generation
Supports anime shows and multi-episode or special releases
caveats: GitHub issues are deprecated; bug tracking and support happen on Discord
Switching from other forks requires backing up or removing existing database files
